items.title: Chevron to begin offshore oil and gas exploration in Greece
items.summary: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY are set to begin seismic surveys for oil and gas in Greece’s southern Ionian Sea. The results could help determine whether to drill in a country that relies on imported gas.View on euronews
